name: serverless-inventory-api
description: API POS serverless — Lambda + API Gateway + DynamoDB (documentos JSON)

scripts.start:db: docker rm -f dynamodb-local 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name dynamodb-local -p 8000:8000 amazon/dynamodb-local -jar DynamoDBLocal.jar -sharedDb && sleep 2 && echo 'DynamoDB Local listo en :8000'
scripts.stop:db: docker stop dynamodb-local && docker rm dynamodb-local
scripts.setup:local: npm run start:db; sleep 2 && DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:8000 bash ../db/dynamodb/create-tables-local.sh && npm run seed:local
